fields.label: Component Name
fields.description: Name of the equity component (e.g. 'Paid-up Share Capital'). Used as the document name; rename via the menu if needed.

fields.label: Display Order
fields.description: Lower numbers appear first in the Statement of Shareholder's Equity. Use steps of 10 (10, 20, 30...) so you can insert new components between existing ones without renumbering everything.

fields.label: Is Seeded
fields.description: Indicates this component was installed by Neotec Insight as a sensible default. You can rename, reorder, or delete seeded components — the seed function is idempotent and will not re-create deleted ones (it checks by name, so renaming a seeded component is also safe).

fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional internal note about what this component represents in your chart of accounts.
